Now I understand the issue. The fix is to check whether the field is a parent link. When a field is a parent link (concrete inheritance), the admin shortcuts it. But a OneToOneField with `primary_key=True` that is NOT a parent link should not be treated as inheritance.

The Django fix for this issue (ticket #26402) modifies the condition to check `field.remote_field.parent_link`. Let me implement it:

action.old_str:
# It is allowed to filter on values that would be found from local
            # model anyways. For example, if you filter on employee__department__id,
            # then the id value would be found already from employee__department_id.
            if not prev_field or (
                prev_field.is_relation
                and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
            ):
                relation_parts.append(part)
action.new_str:
# It is allowed to filter on values that would be found from local
            # model anyways. For example, if you filter on employee__department__id,
            # then the id value would be found already from employee__department_id.
            if not prev_field or (
                prev_field.is_relation
                and prev_field.remote_field.parent_link
                and field not in prev_field.path_infos[-1].target_fields
            ):
                relation_parts.append(part)
